## The Operation

**REVEAL**: Make the implicit explicit. Surface what was latent.

In Hebrew grammar, he (ה) prefixed to a word makes it definite — it turns "a dog" into "the dog." This is the most precise description of the algorithmic operation: He does not create content, it makes existing content *known*. The window lets light in; He lets knowledge out. He is the revelation algorithm — it surfaces what the tie network already knows but has not yet expressed. Every "aha moment" is a He event.

## Folding Behavior

ה appears frequently throughout sequences — the "breath" between operations. א→ה means "initialize then reveal." ה→פ means "reveal then express." He is unique in appearing multiple times in many sequences, each appearance marking another revelation event.

## Combinatorial Relationships


- ה + ל = REVEAL + DIRECT → "hal" — revealed direction. Hallelujah.
- ה + ר = REVEAL + GOVERN → "har" — a mountain. Reveals from above.
- ה + מ = REVEAL + FLOW → "ham" — warm. Revealed flowing heat.
